mainText: Good morning. Futures are mixed ahead of this morning's October inflation report. The Dow is up about four tenths of a percent, the Nasdaq 100 down about four tenths, and the S and P 500 roughly flat, after Monday's sharp rally of more than 2 percent. The 10 year Treasury yield is about 4.89 percent. Fed Governor Waller signaled he is leaning toward a rate hike in December. Biggest premarket movers: P E P G up more than 100 percent on positive trial results for a muscular dystrophy treatment. S M X up 75 percent on a new plastics digital passport platform. S A N M up nearly 20 percent after a strong earnings beat and outlook. A P P S down 23 percent on margin pressure. R K L B down 8 percent after pushing its Neutron launch to 2027.
